recognize_zh: 淋巴結右半部由大型上皮樣（epithelioid）細胞片狀取代，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核圓並有核仁，與左側小淋巴球區界線清楚；本圖未見黑色素，需免疫染色（S100、SOX10、Melan-A）確認為轉移性黑色素瘤。
features: Sharply demarcated sheet of large epithelioid cells replacing the right half of the node
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with round to oval vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli
Loosely cohesive growth without gland formation; no melanin pigment visible
Residual lymphoid tissue with a lymphoid follicle and small lymphocytes on the left
Congested vessels at the interface between tumor and lymphoid tissue
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows residual lymphoid tissue with a follicle on the left and a sharply demarcated sheet of large epithelioid cells replacing the cortex on the right. The tumor cells have abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, round vesicular nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli, and grow in solid sheets without gland formation. Melanin pigment is not apparent at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic malignant neoplasm, compatible with metastatic melanoma in the appropriate clinical and immunohistochemical context (S100, SOX10, Melan-A, HMB45).

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is more cohesive, may form glands or nests with desmoplasia, and is cytokeratin positive and melanocytic-marker negative.
ALCL cells often fill sinuses, include horseshoe-shaped hallmark cells and are CD30 positive (± ALK) and negative for S100/SOX10.
Nodal nevi are small bland melanocytes confined to the capsule or trabeculae, not large atypical cells with nucleoli replacing the parenchyma.
Histiocytes have bland nuclei and are sinusoidal; RDD cells show emperipolesis and are S100 positive but SOX10 and Melan-A negative.
